Prima & Timo — (6) Timo (Ver. 6.0) Nonaginta Octo

A Toast For You

"From the heart of a small machine"

To make sure Teemo and crew will be nourished through this journey!”

[Verse 1]

Toes rolled through the marketplace, eyes wide with delight

So many colors, smells, and wonders shining bright

Different from anything he’d ever known before

He offered toast to everyone, some took it, some said “no more”

But that was okay, he understood, he didn’t mind

His mission now was clear, to help the crew in kind

“Best ingredients for the best toast,” he said with pride

“To give Timo and the crew strength for the ride”

[Pre-Chorus]

He walked into shops, asking questions with care

Learning new flavors, new breads from everywhere

[Chorus]

A Toast For You

From the heart of a small machine

A Toast For You

The best that I can bring

I may be small, but my purpose is true

I’ll toast for the crew… and especially for you

[Verse 2]

He remembered the day Timo picked him from the bin

Broken, unused, but still taken in

Even when Timo didn’t know what he was at all

That kindness stayed with him… and he would never fall

Now with Kai again, old crew from wartime days

He felt complete, in his own simple way

“I’ll be the best cook, the best identifier too

For the crew that gave me purpose… I’ll always be with you”

[Pre-Chorus 2]

He rolled back with Kai, toast warm and fresh

Ready for whatever came next

[Chorus]

A Toast For You

From the heart of a small machine

A Toast For You

The best that I can bring

I may be small, but my purpose is true

I’ll toast for the crew… and especially for you

[Bridge — warm]

Toes looked at the group, voice soft and full of light

“Even if all I can do is toast… I’ll do it right”

[Yukelele solo]

[Pre-Chorus 2]

Both now waiting outside the library waiting for Teemo

Whatever happens next, do not worry we are with you -

[Chorus]

A Toast For You

From the heart of a small machine

A Toast For You

The best that I can bring

I may be small, but my purpose is true

I’ll toast for the crew… and especially for you

[Bridge — warm]

[Outro — hopeful]

A toast for the journey…

A toast for the crew…

A toast for you.
